description: State Environmental Planning Policy (Precincts – Eastern Harbour City) 2021 is a dataset listed in NSW Government open data portal (data.nsw.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by NSW Department of Planning, Housing and Infrastructure. This SEPP contains planning provisions for precincts within the Eastern Harbour City. This SEPP has consolidated and repealed the: - SEPP (State Significant Precincts) 2005 - Darling Harbour Development Plan No. Coverage: New South Wales. The portal files it under the publisher NSW Department of Planning, Housing and Infrastructure. Its tags are EPI, Eastern Harbour City, Growth Centres, HUMAN-ENVIRONMENT-Planning, New consolidated SEPP. It offers 5 resource(s) in arcgis rest service, json, pdf, wfs, wms. The portal shows 2025-10-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-nsw.
